examples.japanese: この{宗教|しゅうきょう}の{聖典|せいてん}は{何百年|なんびゃくねん}も{前|まえ}に{書|か}かれた。
examples.english: The sacred texts of this religion were written hundreds of years ago.

examples.japanese: {聖典|せいてん}の{教|おし}えに{基|もと}づいて{生活|せいかつ}する{人々|ひとびと}が{世界中|せかいじゅう}にいる。
examples.english: There are people all over the world who live their lives based on the teachings of sacred scriptures.

notes:
A general term for authoritative religious texts regarded as sacred or divinely inspired. Can refer to the Bible, the Quran, Buddhist sutras, or the scriptures of any religion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聖典|せいてん}の{教|おし}え: teachings of the scriptures
- {聖典|せいてん}を{学|まな}ぶ: to study the scriptures
- {聖典|せいてん}{研究|けんきゅう}: scriptural studies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経典|きょうてん}: sutra, religious text — often specifically Buddhist scriptures
- {聖書|せいしょ}: the Bible — specifically the Christian scripture
- {教典|きょうてん}: religious canon — the body of authoritative texts of a particular faith
